# Chapter 6: Building Your AI Strategy

## Why You Need a Strategy (Not Just Random Tools)

Many small business owners approach AI implementation like they're shopping at a bazaar—seeing a shiny new tool, buying it on impulse, trying it for a week, then abandoning it when it doesn't magically solve all their problems. This approach leads to wasted money, frustrated teams, and skepticism about AI's value.

A proper AI strategy changes everything. Instead of random acts of AI, you get:
